description: Configure the Jitsi Meet deployment to enforce High Definition (720p) video by default. You must modify the server-side web configuration to set 'resolution' to 720, 'startBitrate' to '4000', and configure the 'constraints' object to strictly request 720p video height (ideal, min, and max). After configuring, restart the web container to apply changes. Finally, join the room 'HDTestRoom', verify the settings in the 'Video Quality' menu, and save the currently served configuration file to ~/served_config.js.
